title: An Octopus Has Three Hearts, and Swimming Stops the Main One
subject: octopus

scenes.text: An octopus has three hearts. Swimming makes the main one stop.
Two small hearts push blood through its gills. The big third heart feeds the rest of the body.
When an octopus swims, it squirts water from its body, and the big heart pauses.
Swimming also disrupts its breathing, because it uses the same water stream to breathe and to move.
So it would rather crawl along the seabed than swim.
Its blood is blue, carried by copper instead of iron. Three hearts, and it still prefers to walk.

description:
An octopus has three hearts, and the main one stops while it swims.
It crawls instead, because jet swimming disrupts both its heartbeat and its breathing.
Would you rather walk than swim?
first_comment: Which would you give up, the blue blood or the three hearts? What should we cover next?
